page.overview:
Who is Cybertron Cannon?

The Cybertron Cannon is an Explosive Weapon in Fortnite: Battle Royale. It was introduced in Chapter 4: Season 3.

The Cybertron Cannon fires quick projectiles which deal splash damage in a wide radius. The weapon inflicts knockback on the player and the player(s) hit with the projectile. It requires a short charge-up before being able to shoot, and it can be kept in the charged-up state indefinitely until the attack button is released or the player switches to another weapon. After switching to the Cybertron Cannon from another weapon or after Sprinting, a transforming animation will play, during which charging up or shooting the weapon is impossible.

The Cybertron Cannon has 2 charges which take 30s to recharge after being fired. It uses no Ammo and has no headshot multiplier.

The Cybertron Cannon can be found as Chest or floor Loot.
